cast.characterName: マイケル・ギャラガー
cast.originalCharacterName: マイケル・ギャラガー

segments.text: Class 2-A's class representative, who is both a hard worker and a person who is willing to take on any task that no one else will.
While she acts kind and friendly, it is actually a facade that secretly hides the real her, who is manipulative and cunning.
From AniDB
She is the protagonist's childhood friend who, despite having a big appetite, avidly reads the dieting books in their school library. She is a member of the Tea Club.
From AniDB

One of the protagonist's childhood friends and class 2-A classmate, she is often seen with his other friend Masayoshi. She is unpredictable as she would punch the protagonist anytime. She works part-time at a family restaurant to support her single mother, who later dates another man.
From AniDB

A friend and classmate of Miya's. Having studied at an all-girls school for most of her life, Sae is incredibly shy around men. Because of that, she has a soft, quiet voice. Though generally reserved, she shows a child-like enthusiasm for the Inago Mask superheroes.
From Wikipedia
A friend and classmate of Miya's. She is part of their school's girl swimming team. She has a younger brother named Ikuo and possesses a cool, calm disposition.
From AniDB

A very popular girl in her final year who has many fans at school. She can be described as a fickle and insecure girl with a liking for cute things, especially puppies. Her best friend is Hibiki Tsukahara and she has one older brother and two younger brothers. She is a quarter British from her mother, whose family's surname is Lovely (thus Haruka's middle name) which was also given to her by her British grandfather. Possibly as a nod to her heritage, she frequently mixes English phrases into her speech.
From Wikipedia

Protagonist's younger sister, who playfully calls her brother, "Nii-ni". She tends to be jealous when her brother is with another girl, with the exceptions of Sae, Ai and Rihoko, who are her close friends. Her favorite food is nikuman, which she frequently brings up in conversation, often completely out of context. She often wakes her brother up when it is time for school, though she wakes up earlier. She has a very distinctive laugh.
From AniDB

Class 2-A's homeroom teacher. Usually a serious teacher, she can easily get drunk when she drinks sake. She actually has a mini route within Ai's route. The 2nd Amagami Chotto Omake Gekijou fan disc expands on this mini-route, making her a winnable heroine.
From Wikipedia

Protagonist's best friend since childhood, who has an interest in Japanese idols. He often purchases photo books of them and shares them with the protagonist. His family owns a sushi shop, which he plans to inherit.
From AniDB
Haruka's best friend who is captain of the girls' swimming team and Ai's senior. She tends to berate Haruka's playful nature.
From Wikipedia

A secret character in the game and anime. A shy girl, Risa has been in love with the protagonist since grade school and has been secretly stalking him since. Risa is also the one responsible for what happened two years ago under the belief she was protecting the protagonist.
In the Amagami Official Complete Guide, she is listed as a student of class 2-B but in the game, she is a student from class 2-C.
From AniDB
A close friend of Rihoko's. She later wins the Miss Santa Contest during the Kibitou High School's Founder's Festival should Haruka not participate.
From AniDB
A friend of Kaoru. A quiet girl, Kaoru and Junichi once gave her some advice about her crush with another boy.
From AniDB
